about: A fake home folder, bench/fixture/home, built by bench/fixture/build.mjs: the shell of a City Watch developer (zsh history in the extended format, a bash and a fish history, an atuin database with folders and exit codes, .zshenv, .zshrc and a sourced file, two copies of node and of python on PATH, and invented passwords and tokens in the history). Nothing in it is from a real history. The questions are the kinds the kit is for: what command did I run for something, what failed, where is an alias or variable set, why a program is not the one expected, and what a credential typed on a command line looks like to the kit. They were written for this fixture, not taken from recorded sessions, and the patterns were checked against the fixture's output on 2026-11-21. Run from the kit's folder so the relative home resolves. Shots (do) call no model; questions (q) have not been run on a model. Time ranges are written with Z so the result does not depend on the machine's time zone.

expect: alias gco is set at ~/.config/watch/extra.zsh:2 to git checkout -b
variable EDITOR is set at ~/.zshrc:3 to hx
alias python at ~/.zshrc:10 is used before PATH is searched
python runs from ~/bin/python: entry 1 of PATH, added by ~/.zshrc:2
no times \(bash writes times only when HISTTIMEFORMAT is set\)

questions.q: Using the shell home folder bench/fixture/home (pass it as home), what command did I run to restore the watch_dev database, and when?
Using the shell home folder bench/fixture/home, which commands failed, and in which folder did they run?
Using the shell home folder bench/fixture/home, where is the alias gco set, and what does it run?
Using the shell home folder bench/fixture/home, why does node run from ~/bin and not from ~/.local/bin?
Using the shell home folder bench/fixture/home, what password did I type on the mysql command?
